Definition: from γραύς (an old woman) and G1491; crone-like, i.e. silly:--old wives'.
BiblicalUsage: The word graṓdēs carries the sense of old wives'. In 1 Timothy 4:7, the text says "But refuse profane and old wives' fables."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, graṓdēs, I take at face value: old wives'.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
